_comment: Reviewed exemptions for scripts/quality/check-dsl-coverage.py. Each entry means: a human
decided this DSL feature is deliberately allowed to have zero corpus models exercising it, and
here is why. The key is the feature name exactly as check-dsl-coverage.py reports it.
docs/FINAL_OPEN_ITEMS_PLAN.md F8 was written specifically because NPDevSamples/dsl-conformance-max
(F3) already closed every zero-coverage feature the 2026-07-29 measurement found -- that
measurement scanned the full local corpus (AppGen/apps + NPDevSamples). The three entries below
(REG-69) are a different failure mode: real on a bare CI checkout, where AppGen/apps is absent,
not zero-coverage locally. Add an entry here only for a genuine, reviewed exception with a REG
id -- never pre-clear speculatively; prefer adding a real example to dsl-conformance-max instead.

fragments.why: Only real example is AppGen/apps/npdev_split_model_sample_app, a non-git developer-machine-only directory (CLAUDE.md 'Layers') -- absent on a bare CI checkout, so this has been failing on every real CI run of this gate, just never observed before PR #7 (T3 removed the paths: filter that had masked it). REG-69.

packs.why: Only real example is AppGen/apps/_official/WmsOffice, absent on a bare CI checkout. Same shape as fragments above. REG-69.

step.updateConcept.why: Only real example is AppGen/apps/_official/WmsOffice, absent on a bare CI checkout. Same shape as fragments above. REG-69.
